summary: Prefer Fractal socket names in paired adapters, scripts and deployment examples

replay.detail: No event or replication replay change.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema change.

compatibility.detail: Default script readers prefer fractal.sock or fractal-client.sock with legacy-name fallback. The ChatGPT adapter accepts both paired gateway names and rejects both control socket names. Explicit endpoints remain exact.

downtime.detail: No planned downtime; the existing daemon aliases and nonblocking Rust discovery remain unchanged.

manual.detail: No action for default discovery. Home Manager and deployment examples select the Fractal-named paired gateway.

recovery.detail: Legacy-only daemon discovery remains supported during the socket-name migration.
